title: Seasonal false alarms in customer churn and decline early-warning systems: adjacent-window labels confound seasonality with decline, and a year-over-year correction
abstract: arXiv:2608.18174v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Customer decline early-warning systems feed account-manager action lists, and every flagged account consumes intervention capacity. In a deployed business-to-business marketplace system, one action-list slot in three went to flags that dissolve under a seasonally aligned label. The standard target in non-contractual churn prediction compares an entity's next k months of activity with its trailing k months. The two windows cover different calendar months, so for seasonal entities the threshold-ratio construction confounds seasonality with decline, and the event rate depends on the label's anchor calendar month. We formalize the mechanism and measure it on three public panels and the production panel (the public arms pre-specified). Of the adjacent-window decay events, 37--69% on the public panels and 28--50% in production have no counterpart under a seasonally aligned definition. translated_title: 客户流失与衰退预警系统中的季节性误报：相邻窗口标签混淆季节性与衰退，以及年度同比修正
translated_abstract: 客户衰退预警系统为账户经理的行动列表提供输入，每个被标记的账户都会消耗干预资源。在一个已部署的企业对企业市场平台系统中，每三个行动列表槽位中就有一个被在季节性对齐标签下会消失的标记所占用。非合同型流失预测中的标准目标是将实体未来k个月的活动与其过去k个月进行比较。由于两个窗口覆盖不同的日历月份，对于季节性实体，阈值比率构建会将季节性效应与衰退混淆，事件发生率取决于标签的锚定日历月份。我们在三个公开面板和实际生产面板上形式化并量化了这一机制（公开部分预先指定）。在相邻窗口的衰退事件中，公开面板上的37%-69%和生产中的28%-50%在季节性对齐定义下没有对应事件。池化锚点，即标准的补救方法，平衡了训练数据，但并未消除这种混淆。
tldr: 本文揭示了客户流失预警系统中因相邻窗口标签设计而混淆季节性与衰退导致的系统性误报问题，并提出年度同比修正方法以减少虚假警报。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that adjacent-window labels in churn early-warning systems systematically confound seasonality with decline, causing 28-69% false alarms, and proposes a year-over-year correction to mitigate the issue.
